parameters.content:
## Ingest vessel data
Receive real-time vessel data through the webhook, including speed, RPM, engine load, fuel consumption, weather, and voyage information.

## How It Works

This workflow helps vessel operators and fleet teams reduce fuel consumption using AI-driven prediction and optimization. Vessel data enters through a webhook, is normalized, combined with historical vessel data, and compared with a statistical baseline. AI agents then predict fuel consumption, optimize operating conditions, and generate recommendations. Safety guardrails validate decisions before results are recorded and routed by severity. Critical and warning conditions trigger email alerts, while routine results require no alert. A scheduled reporting flow summarizes fleet performance for continuous monitoring and improvement.

## Setup Steps

1. Configure webhook and vessel data.
2. Connect historical-data storage.
3. Configure AI models and schemas.
4. Connect Gmail for alerts.
5. Set schedule and thresholds.

## Prerequisites

n8n, vessel data source, AI model/API, historical database or spreadsheet, and Gmail credentials.

## Use Cases

Fuel optimization, voyage planning, fleet monitoring, anomaly alerts, and daily performance reporting.

## Customization

Adjust AI models, thresholds, data sources, alerts, and optimization constraints.

## Benefits

Lower fuel consumption, safer decisions, faster monitoring, explainable recommendations, and continuous fleet learning.

## Predict fuel consumption
The Fuel Prediction Agent estimates fuel consumption using vessel history, operating conditions, and environmental factors.

## Generate recommendations
The Advisory Agent converts optimization results into clear, explainable recommendations for operators.

### Record and report results
Store results, route alerts by severity, and generate scheduled fleet reports.Historical results support performance tracking, model improvement, and future optimization.

## Normalize and enrich data
Standardize incoming data, retrieve historical vessel records, aggregate context, and establish a statistical baseline.

## Optimize vessel operation
The Optimization Agent evaluates operating options and identifies fuel-efficient conditions while considering operational constraints.

## Apply safety guardrails and Commendation
Validate recommendations against predefined safety and operational limits before recording or sending alerts.

## Send Alert
Record events and send alerts when predefined conditions or thresholds are met.
